games.headline: The Canberra Mob outlasts Ken
article: The Canberra Mob beat Ken 96.20 to 93.00 in Week 1, a nail-biter decided by 3.20 points.

The Canberra Mob managed 96.20 this week, 18.6 under their projected 114.8. Steelers D/ST carried them with 20.0 points, 12.0 over his projection. Breece Hall (18.8) and Justin Herbert (14.9) were the other big contributors.
Ken managed 93.00 this week, 12.1 under their projected 105.1 and the 3rd-lowest score of the week. Jayden Daniels led the way with 21.1, and DJ Moore added 19.5.
The letdown for Ken was Harrison Mevis, who managed 1.0 on a 8.7 projection.
The letdown for The Canberra Mob was Rico Dowdle, who managed 3.1 on a 11.8 projection.

Here's the painful part for Ken: starting Trevor Lawrence (33.3) instead of Jayden Daniels (21.1) and Michael Pittman Jr. (7.3) instead of DeVonta Smith (6.8) would have produced 105.70 points, enough to win.
The Canberra Mob could have scored even more by starting Jordan Mason (11.9) instead of Rico Dowdle (3.1) and Matthew Golden (12.5) instead of A.J. Brown (4.1).
At quarterback, Jayden Daniels (21.1) outdueled Justin Herbert (14.9).
The Canberra Mob improves to 1-0 (6th place). Ken drops to 0-1 (10th).
Next week, The Canberra Mob faces Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup (0-1), who are coming off a 40.9-point loss to K9 Unit.
Next week, Ken faces Stroud and Proud (0-1), who are coming off a 26.1-point loss to I Call Gibbs.
